prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
